header.label: Foundation engineering
header.title: Open Pile Plan Studio
header.desc: Bring load points, CPTs, foundation advice, pile options, utilization and estimated costs together in one interactive pile plan.
header.caution: Engineering results are decision support and must always be checked by a qualified professional.

intro.label: One plan, all decision data
intro.title: From load point to substantiated pile choice
intro.p1: Open Pile Plan Studio makes the relationship between structural loads, nearby CPTs and available pile configurations immediately visible.
intro.p2: Select one or more load points, compare valid options by tip level, utilization, governing CPT and estimated cost, and record the chosen configuration in the same project.

features.label: Features
features.title: Work directly from source data to pile plan

import.title: Purposeful project import
import.desc: Import load points, CPT coordinates and foundation advice from CSV or XLSX files and assign the three source roles before import.

selection.title: Select CPTs
selection.desc: Select CPTs automatically by quadrant or maximum-angle rules and override the choice manually for individual load points.

options.title: Compare pile options
options.desc: Review valid, insufficient and missing pile options per location with size, tip level and governing CPT.

assign.title: Assign one or many
assign.desc: Assign a configuration to one load point or to a multiple selection with common options.

compare.title: Utilization and cost
compare.desc: Compare utilization, governing CPT and estimated cost before recording a configuration.

optimize.title: Optimize the plan
optimize.desc: Use the current greedy optimizer with configuration limits as decision support for an efficient pile plan.

interact.title: Interactive selection
interact.desc: Select locations by click, multi-selection or lasso and filter through pile size and tip level in the legend.

project.title: IFCPP project file
project.desc: Keep imported data, settings, pile choices and manual CPT selections together and reopen the complete project later.

sample.title: Explore immediately
sample.desc: The browser demo opens with a complete sample project, so you can investigate the workflow without preparation.

workflow.label: Workflow
workflow.title: Three steps to a traceable project

step1.title: Combine sources
step1.desc: Import load points, CPTs and foundation advice and verify their role.

step2.title: Assess options
step2.desc: Inspect the plan, CPT selection, bearing capacity, utilization and cost.

step3.title: Record choices
step3.desc: Assign configurations, review the whole plan and save everything as an IFCPP project.

limits.label: Transparent boundaries
limits.title: Decision support, not automated design responsibility
limits.desc1: The configurable CPT selection is a practical approximation. The greedy optimizer helps compare choices but does not guarantee a globally optimal pile plan.
limits.desc2: Always have a qualified professional verify input, assumptions and engineering results within the project.

tech.label: Shared calculation core
tech.title: The same engineering logic in browser and desktop
tech.desc: Engineering logic for imports, pile options, costs, CPT selection and optimization lives in the Rust core. The same core runs through WebAssembly in the browser and natively in the Tauri desktop app.

cta.title: Explore the sample project
cta.desc: Open the browser demo and see directly how load points, CPTs and pile options come together in one workspace.
